title: Plea Of The Long-Legged Uncle
paragraphs: After that, I went through several more loops and got scolded by big sister over and over again. Well, a lot happened. Even the tiniest mistake would mess up the flow of the original world. I tried secretly giving Father some money and making various arrangements, but they all ended in failure. The more I tried to adjust things, the more off-track it got. It got annoying, so I sided with Father and repeated the same kind of loop as before. About a month later, big sister showed up and gave me a long lecture before forcing the loop again. I get the feeling that big sister’s opinion of me is gradually going down. So, after repeating the loop enough times, I decided to try and earn her approval. I went along with the crimson swine’s conspiracy, suffered a stomach ulcer while denouncing Father, and then left things alone to some extent. Then, one night…
“…Phew.”
Finally, when Father bought big sister as a slave and had her tending the fire while he took a nap, I appeared wearing a mask and carrying a sack.
When little big sister tried to wake Father, I stopped her and put a finger to my lips like it was a secret. Then I offered some medicine and food.
“A present. It’ll help you feel better.”
“Ah, th-thank you…?”
I even gave Father some small tools to help him and left a toy for big sister, then slipped away.
“DIIIIIIIIEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!!”
“Guhh!?”

This time, I took big sister’s full-force attack head-on and got blown away! Of course, this is Melromarc Castle. Next to me lies this loop’s version of big sister—burned to a crisp. When I checked her pulse, she was already gone.
How did it end up like this…?
“You were the tall man giving us gifts all this time, weren’t you?!”
“N-no, I wasn’t!”
“I recognize that voice! Why were you doing all that?”
This loop’s big sister cozily linked her arm with mine and looked over at Father.
“Naofumi, this man is—”

Father looked at big sister—who was clinging to me—with the same expression he had when he was framed by the crimson swine. …Right after that, flames of rage erupted from Father and incinerated everything around him, including the crowd. Well, I survived it, but Ren, Itsuki, the crimson swine, and Trash are all barely hanging on. Father is now slowly swaying as he walks, glaring at empty space—either blinded by rage or scaring off anyone near him.
“…This place… is hell. A world built on malice… everything is against me… A world like this should just perish! Stay away! Disappear! No one… no one believes me… it’s a nightmare…”

He was consumed by rage, swinging his fists at invisible illusions. At that point, only big sister and I could still move properly. I had been trying to support Father and big sister, sneaking in gifts every night while Father slept and big sister dozed off. Because they might die in the waves. I never imagined trying to ease that anxiety would lead to this result. Father and the others seemed to notice that someone unknown was helping them, and began leveling up with a bit more enthusiasm. They didn’t know who it was, but they accepted the gifts. Even Father looked a little happy. That’s when big sister started secretly referring to me as the tall man. Well, my legs *are* longer than average. Father also started showing signs that he might believe someone out there was on his side. It felt like things were going pretty well… or so I thought. After the wave ended, just like planned, I heard from the crimson swine and challenged Father to a duel to get big sister freed. Also as planned, the crimson swine’s interference cornered me, and I let Father win. Right after big sister slapped me and stepped in close— Some kind of intuition, or maybe her abilities, made her realize I was the one supporting Father and the others, and she started speaking to me in a friendly tone.
And… you already know the rest.
“Now then… it’s confession time. Just what exactly did you do?”
“You’re wrong! It’s not like that! I acted with good intentions! This is all a misunderstanding!”
Even though I should’ve become this strong, why can’t I do anything against big sister?
“I’m sick of hearing that excuse. Never mind me being here—let’s get to the bottom of how things ended up like this, shall we?”
Big sister gave me a stern glare, just like Father in the original world. She’s swinging her hammer through the air. If I say the wrong thing now, she might really kill me this time.
“That’s why I’m saying—it’s all a misunderstanding!”
I explained everything to big sister. There’s no shine left in her eyes. She’s seriously scary…
And actually… her timing was ridiculously perfect.
“…That’s the situation.”
“…So Naofumi saw that, and misunderstood, thinking I had switched over to your side.”

Exactly. She had been just about to speak to Father. If her next words had been “Thank you for everything,” it would’ve been despair—but knowing big sister, I think she was going to tell Father that I was the tall man.
“Is this some kind of challenge to me? You’re deliberately trying to break my patience, aren’t you?”
“You’re wrong! That wasn’t my intention!”
“Then why did you make it seem like I betrayed Naofumi!?”
“That’s why I said it was an unfortunate chain of coincidences. More than anything, it’s because of big sister’s sharp instincts and abilities!”
“So you’re saying it’s my fault?”
Big sister’s rage is reaching MAX level. I should calm her down and reset the loop. That’s the best move now.
“Alright then. I’ve heard enough excuses. Now die!”
“Ugh!?”

With a *boom*, in an instant, big sister had moved right in front of me and sent me flying with her hammer. Next thing I knew, I was soaring far above the Melromarc castle, and big sister was floating behind me. And she was already swinging her hammer again in the opposite direction.

“Because the repulsion of entering this world is stronger than usual, I figured things were going as planned… but instead, I had to watch the humiliation of being misunderstood as someone who betrayed Naofumi and switched over to you! Rifana’s resolve, Gaelion’s feelings, everyone’s hopes—it’s all been ruined!”
With a *crash*, I was slammed into the ground.
“Ugh…! I-I was seriously trying my best!”
“You’re putting your effort in the wrong direction!”
“That’s why, big sister, don’t you think maybe Sakura-chan isn’t actually Filo?”
“…Enough already.”
Even though I made a logical point, big sister turned away from me and began to float off.
What does she mean by “enough already”…?
“I’ll report to Naofumi that I failed to retrieve you. I wanted to tread carefully and take out that goddess, but I suppose there’s no helping it.”
W-what did she just say!? And now she’s looking at me like I’m the scum of the earth.

“Until we defeat the goddess together, suffer endlessly in a prison that’s basically infinite, never able to meet Filo again, struggling in agony. And even if you do manage to survive by some miracle, I’ll personally come with Naofumi to kill you. Prepare yourself.”
N-no more Filo-tan!? I refuseeeeeee! I’m reflecting! Please forgive meeeeee!
“O-one more chance! One more chance, big sister!”
I desperately clung to big sister’s leg, begging her. Since she’s in her Raph species form, it’s not just her leg—I’m wrapped around most of her body.
“Let go! I don’t have time to waste on you!”
Big sister tried to shake me off.
At this rate, she’s going to get away!
“I’ll do everything exactly the way you said! I’ll act just like in the original world! So please! I’m begging you—this is my final wish!”
I threw away all pride and begged big sister with everything I had. After a moment of visibly cycling through anger and frustration, she let out a deep sigh.
“…I’ll give you credit for trying so stubbornly to help Naofumi in this looping world. Even now, I guess you only did all that because you wanted to help.”
Big sister let out another, *deep* breath.
Does that mean… I get to live?

“…This really is your last chance. It’s incredibly difficult to enter this world, I say. Especially when I’m alive, it takes a lot of time. Though… it seems like in most loops, I’m in a near-death state anyway.”
Oh? Big sister is alive? I didn’t know that. I’ll make sure to remember it.
“I was honestly shocked that I got in so easily this time.”
Now that she mentions it, I think she did say something about repulsion.
“Ah, and even if the Spear Hero came up with the completely absurd idea that destroying the egg Filo is supposed to hatch from might let her in—don’t even think about it. You can’t do it.”
“I wasn’t thinking that at all!”
Highly suspicious! But destroy Sakura-chan’s egg!? That’s absolutely unthinkable!
“Anyway, next time is the last. Make sure you meet Filo properly! If everything goes well, I might be able to pull you out through the cracks.”
“Yes, ma’am!”
“Then…”
For some reason, big sister’s gripping her hammer with both hands and winding up.
Don’t tell me…!?
“This is for making Naofumi think I was stolen from him!”

With a *smash* and searing pain, my consciousness blacked out. So this is what Itsuki meant by me dying and the loop resetting. She’s getting rougher with each round… But next time, I *have* to succeed. And so, I began the final loop.
